fact: On 12 November 2026 a former justice minister told a round table in Nouakchott that Mauritania's criminal code must be revised and updated to meet the challenges of AI and cybercrime, while a diagnostic study of the 2025-2029 national AI strategy was discussed.
title: منتدى الأواصر يقترح تعديلات لتعزيز حماية البيانات في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي
